Privacy policy

We keep what the site needs to work and nothing for advertising. You can download everything we hold about you, or delete it, from your dashboard.

1. In short

  • An account holds your name, email address, a securely hashed password, the markets you follow, your saved reports and your reading history.
  • The site runs no analytics, no session recording, no advertising and no third party trackers. Fonts and scripts are served from our own domain.
  • Your account data is stored with Supabase, our database and sign in provider.
  • We never sell or rent personal data.
  • You can download all of it or delete all of it at any time from your dashboard.

2. Who is responsible

Leoside Equity is the controller of the personal data described here (the "data fiduciary" under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023). For anything about your data, including a complaint, write to support@leosideequity.com with "Privacy" in the subject. Messages there are handled by the person responsible for privacy at Leoside Equity, who is also the contact for grievances under the Indian act.

3. What we hold

When you create an account

  • Name and email address. What you type, or what Google gives us if you use Google sign in.
  • Password. Stored by Supabase only as a bcrypt hash, which cannot be turned back into the password. We never see it.
  • Age band. Whether you are 13 to 17 or 18 and over, whether a parent or guardian agreed (for 13 to 17), and when the check was done. You enter your date of birth, but it is used in your browser for the check and is never sent to us or stored.
  • Terms acceptance. Which version of the terms you accepted and when.
  • Markets you follow. Your choice of the United States, the United Kingdom and India.
  • Campaign source, only if you allowed it. If you arrived through a link carrying campaign codes (such as utm_source) and chose "Allow campaign details", those codes, the site that referred you and the page you landed on are stored with your new account.

While you use the account

  • Saved reports and reading history. Which reports you saved, when, and when you removed them; the last reports you opened and when.
  • Profile photo, if you add one. Cropped and shrunk to 256 pixels in your browser before upload, which also removes camera data such as location. It is visible only to you.
  • Sign in records. Supabase records when you signed in and the sessions that keep you signed in.

From everyone, signed in or not

  • Request logs. Like every website, the servers that deliver the site and the database record technical details of each request, including IP address, browser type, the page requested and the time.
  • Error reports. If the site breaks in your browser, it sends us the page address (without anything after a question mark), the error message, the file and line, your browser family (for example "Chrome 130") and, if you are signed in, your account ID. No IP address is stored with these.
  • Messages you send us. Your email and what you wrote.

4. What we do not collect

No payment details (there is nothing to pay for), no stored date of birth, no postal address, no identity documents, no portfolio or holdings, no location tracking, no analytics, no session replay or screen recording, no advertising identifiers and no data bought from anyone else. If you send us any of this unasked, we delete it.

What we doData usedLegal basis (GDPR and UK GDPR)

Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, we process your data on the basis of the consent you give when you create an account, and for the legitimate uses the act allows, such as data you provide voluntarily for a service you ask for and compliance with the law.

6. Cookies and browser storage

The site sets no cookies of its own. It keeps a few small items in your browser's local storage and session storage. All but one are strictly necessary for something you asked for, so they need no consent. The one optional item is only written if you choose "Allow campaign details" in the cookie banner.

What is storedWhyKept forType
Your sign in session, placed by the sign in service our database provider suppliesKeeps you signed in between pages and visitsUntil you sign out, or until the tab closes if "Keep me signed in" is untickedEssential
Your "Keep me signed in" choiceDecides whether the session above outlasts the tabUntil you change itEssential
Your answer to the cookie bannerSo the banner is not shown again, and so the site respects your answerUntil you change itEssential
Your themeLight or dark, if you chose oneUntil you change itEssential
A copy of the list of published reports, in session storageSaves downloading the list again on every pageTwo minutes, and cleared when the tab closesEssential
The time of a sign up attempt by someone under 13 (nothing else)Stops an immediate second attempt with a different date of birth24 hoursEssential
A note that the "add to home screen" tip was shown, on iPhone and iPad onlySo the tip appears onceUntil you clear site dataEssential
Unsaved report text, for administrators onlyProtects a report being written against a closed tabUntil the report is savedEssential
The campaign link that brought you here, only if you allowed itAttached to your account if you sign up, so we know which campaigns bring readers30 days, or until you withdraw consentOptional

If you install the site as an app, your browser also keeps a copy of the site's own files so it opens without a connection. No personal data is kept in that copy.

Change your choice at any time with in the footer. Clearing your browser's site data removes all of the above and signs you out.

7. Email

We send only the messages an account needs: confirming your address, password reset links you ask for, and notices about security or changes to our terms. Each one says why you received it. We do not send marketing or newsletters, and we never sell, rent or share email addresses. Because these messages are part of running the account, the way to stop them is to delete the account.

8. Who else handles it

We do not sell personal data or share it for anyone else's marketing. These providers process it for us, under contract, only to run the service:

ProviderWhat they doData involved
Supabase, Inc. (United States), running on Amazon Web ServicesDatabase, sign in, sending account emails, request logsEverything held with your account; IP address and request details
Our website hosting and content delivery providerDelivers the site's files and protects it from attacksIP address and request details
Google LLC, only if you choose "Continue with Google"Confirms who you areGoogle tells us your name and email address. Google's own privacy policy covers what it does.

We may also disclose data where the law requires it, to protect people's safety or our legal rights, or to a business that takes over the service, which would have to protect it at least as well as this policy does. We would tell account holders before any such transfer.

9. Where it is stored

Leoside Equity is run from India. Supabase and our host may store and process data in the United States, the European Union or elsewhere. Where data leaves the United Kingdom or the European Economic Area, we rely on the safeguards the law provides, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses and the UK addendum to them, which our providers include in their data processing terms.

11. How we protect it

Every connection is encrypted and browsers are told to use HTTPS only. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. The database refuses any request to read or change another member's data, whatever the request claims, and member writes are rate limited. The site's code is served under a strict content security policy that blocks scripts from anywhere else. We collect as little as we can in the first place.

No system is perfectly secure. If a breach puts your rights at risk, we will tell you and the relevant authorities within the time the law sets, which is 72 hours for the authorities under the GDPR.

12. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you have some or all of these rights:

  • Access and portability. Get a copy of your data in a machine readable file. Use "Download my data" in your dashboard for an instant copy.
  • Correction. Change your name and preferences in your dashboard, or ask us to fix anything else.
  • Deletion. Use "Delete my account" in your dashboard, or ask us.
  • Objection and restriction. Object to processing based on our legitimate interests, or ask us to pause it while a question is resolved.
  • Withdrawing consent. Change your cookie choice at any time. It does not affect anything done before.
  • In India: a summary of your data and of whom it was shared with, correction and erasure, grievance redressal through the contact in section 2, and the right to nominate someone to exercise your rights if you die or become unable to.
  • In California and other US states with privacy laws: to know, access, correct and delete your data, and not to be treated differently for using these rights. We do not sell or share personal data as those laws define it.

For anything not in the dashboard, write to us. We may need to confirm it is you, normally by replying to the email address on the account. We answer within 30 days, free of charge.

13. Children

The service is not for children under 13. We ask for a date of birth before an account is created, refuse anyone under 13, and do not store the date. People aged 13 to 17 need a parent or guardian's agreement. If we learn that we hold data about a child under 13, we delete it. If you are a parent and think your child has an account, write to us and we will delete it. When the parts of India's data protection rules on children take effect, we will ask for verifiable parental consent for Indian users under 18 in the way those rules require.

14. Automated decisions

We make no decisions about you by automated means that have legal or similarly significant effects. The age check simply applies the age limits in the terms to the date you enter.

15. Privacy signals

If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, the site treats it as a refusal of the optional campaign storage and does not show the cookie banner. The site does not track you across other websites, so a Do Not Track signal changes nothing in practice.

16. Changes to this policy

We update this policy when the site or the law changes. The date at the top shows the current version. If a change materially affects how we handle your data, we will tell account holders by email or with a clear notice on the site before it takes effect.

17. Contact and complaints

Write to support@leosideequity.com. We would rather hear from you first, but you can also complain to a regulator: in the United Kingdom, the Information Commissioner's Office; in the European Union, the data protection authority where you live or work; in India, the Data Protection Board of India once you have used our grievance process.
